title: Rav Achdevoi, Brother of Mar Acha
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 111b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.111b.7) (Hyman cites 111a). Dikdukei Soferim reads Rav Achdevoi bar Ami; Hyman reports that all the old printings have Rav Acha, brother of Mar Acha, and so it is in Seder HaDorot under the entry Rav Acha.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text places Achdevoi, brother of Mar Acha, at Shabbat 111b; Hyman supplies 111a. Hyman’s reported old-printing forms and printing-history explanation are kept as his report, without claiming those pages were inspected.

The linked 111b passage names Rav Achdevoi, brother of Mar Acha, asking about a bow knot. [Shabbat 111a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.111a.4) instead has Rav Acha Arikha, identified there as Rav Acha bar Papa. The old-printing variants are reported by Hyman.
